nodes.label: Bilingual Parser
nodes.rationale: Parses spoken commands in English and Hindi (Hinglish supported) and routes them to the appropriate backend module.

nodes.label: Bilingual Voice Commands (200+)
nodes.rationale: 100+ English and 100+ Hindi commands across 9 categories, giving voice access to every feature.

nodes.label: Hinglish (Mixed Language) Support
nodes.rationale: Mixed Hindi-English phrases like 'Chrome kholo' and 'Volume badhao' are understood without forcing a single language.

nodes.label: Web Search Integration
nodes.rationale: Smarter 'new tab' and 'search' command parsing for seamless browsing.

nodes.label: Human-like Input Delays
nodes.rationale: 50-150ms delays between automated mouse/keyboard actions make input automation feel more natural and less robotic.

nodes.label: Noun-First Hindi Parsing
nodes.rationale: Better support for natural Hindi grammar such as '[Folder] kholo', where the object noun comes before the verb.

nodes.label: Safe Deletion (Recycle Bin)
nodes.rationale: All file deletions move to the recycle bin/trash first so they remain recoverable instead of being permanently destroyed.

nodes.label: Arc Reactor
nodes.rationale: Click-to-activate UI affordance: the user clicks the Arc Reactor to activate JARVIS and begin voice input.

nodes.label: JARVIS
nodes.rationale: Futuristic voice-activated bilingual (English/Hindi) system controller for Windows, macOS and Linux; 100+ commands, full hardware control, local-first with no data collection.

nodes.label: Confirmation System
nodes.rationale: Dangerous actions (shutdown, restart, delete) require explicit user approval, with a 30-second timeout that auto-cancels if no response is received.

nodes.label: PyInstaller Bundling (Build v2.1.0)
nodes.rationale: Optimized PyInstaller bundling produces a faster, lighter executable for distribution.

nodes.label: One-file vs One-dir Packaging
nodes.rationale: One-file: easier to distribute but slower startup; One-dir: faster startup and easier to debug.

nodes.label: backend/.env Configuration
nodes.rationale: Environment variables (BACKEND_PORT, FRONTEND_URL, CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT, LOG_LEVEL, WhatsApp paths, GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY) configure server, security and logging behavior without code changes.

nodes.label: WebSocket Command Message Protocol
nodes.rationale: Uniform JSON envelope {type, command, language, timestamp} so frontend and backend agree on command, response, status, ping/pong and error messages.

nodes.label: Ping/Pong Keep-alive
nodes.rationale: Ping every 30 seconds keeps the WebSocket alive; auto-reconnect every 3 seconds with a maximum of 10 attempts.

nodes.label: System Status Broadcasting
nodes.rationale: Backend auto-broadcasts system stats every 5 seconds so the dashboard updates in real time without polling.

nodes.label: Standard Response Format
nodes.rationale: All responses share the {success, action_type, response, data, error} shape so the frontend can handle every result uniformly.

nodes.label: Tesseract OCR
nodes.rationale: Optional system dependency for text extraction; must be installed and added to the system PATH (e.g. C:\Program Files\Tesseract-OCR on Windows).

nodes.label: WebSocket Communication
nodes.rationale: Real-time bidirectional channel between the React frontend and the FastAPI backend, chosen over pure REST for live status streaming.

nodes.label: Voice Browser Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Chrome and Edge fully support the Web Speech API; Firefox has limited support and Safari none, so voice recognition requires a Chromium-based browser.
